The Elo Peripheral SDK is a Android library that an application can use to access peripherals of ELO POS devices.

About


The Elo Peripheral SDK is a Android library that an application can use to access peripherals of ELO POS devices.

The ELO peripheral SDK supports the following peripherals
  • Cash-Drawer
  • Customer Facing (Character LCD) Display
  • Printer
  • Barcode Scanner
  • Magnetic Stripe Reader
  • FTDI based UART-over-USB
